descriptionChirho: A reed or cane plant growing in marshy areas, also used as a measuring rod (Ezekiel's measuring reed); the basic and most frequent sense of qaneh.
A lateral branch extending from the central shaft of the tabernacle lampstand (menorah), as described in the Exodus specifications.
The central shaft or stem of the tabernacle lampstand (menorah), from which the branches extend.
The stalk or stem on which heads of grain grow, as in Pharaoh's dream (Genesis 41).
A fragrant or sweet cane used as a spice ingredient in the holy anointing oil and incense (Exodus 30, Song of Songs 4, Jeremiah 6, Ezekiel 27).
The beam or bar of a balance or scale used for weighing, as in Isaiah 46:6.
The bone of the upper arm or shoulder joint, as in Job 31:22 where Job speaks of his arm falling from its socket.
